searchText: At ACDC yesterday [we discussed](https://www.youtube.com/live/nV-myyBPbWk?si=3Xt2rLcIQYyLtpVb&t=3225) merging [this PR](https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/pull/3510) but I'm confused about the resolution. Should we (1) wait to merge this into the specs until v1.7.0-alpha.0 which would be released after Fulu is live on mainnet or (2) merge this now and only start to use these new presets in Glamsterdam client code branches? cc <@412614104222531604> <@755590043632140352> I think consensus was to merge after Fulu I’ve set up a dedicated channel for <#1388254528457015317>. Any R&D discussions or todos related to reducing slot durations can be moved there
